$about: Provenance manifest for third-party brand assets. Policy: docs/BRAND-ASSETS.md.
Every file under assets/brands/ must have an entry here or CI fails.
JSON has no comments, so the documentation lives in these $-prefixed keys.
scripts/verify-assets.ts ignores $-keys when checking coverage — they are notes,
not entries — but it still refuses any object anywhere in this file that sets
There are deliberately no real entries yet: no logo file has been retrieved from a
vendor's own brand page and reviewed. An empty manifest is the honest state.

<vendor-slug>.files: string[] — paths relative to assets/brands/. Non-empty, no leading / and no '..'.
<vendor-slug>.sourceUrl: string — https:// URL of the vendor's OWN brand/press/media-kit page. Never guessed, never a CDN hotlink, never example.com.
<vendor-slug>.retrievedAt: string — YYYY-MM-DD, the day a human downloaded the file from sourceUrl.
<vendor-slug>.licence: string — the terms the asset is used under, in the vendor's own words where they state them.
<vendor-slug>.constraints: string — what the vendor forbids (recolouring, reproportioning, implying endorsement).
<vendor-slug>.usage: string[] — the product surfaces this mark appears on.
<vendor-slug>.sha256: object — one lowercase 64-char hex digest per listed file. Proves the byte content has not been swapped since review.
<vendor-slug>.generated: boolean — must be false. true is a hard CI failure; AI-drawn marks are forbidden (ADR-002).

$example.$note: A complete entry, shown for shape only. The values below are placeholders and this key is skipped by the coverage check; a real entry is named for its vendor and its sourceUrl points at that vendor's site.
$example.sourceUrl: https://<the vendor's own brand or press page>
$example.licence: Trademark of <Vendor>, used nominatively to identify the service. Not covered by this repository's MIT licence.
$example.constraints: No modification of colour or proportion. Not an endorsement or affiliation.
